description: Worker entered confined space without completing gas testing and permit verification.
Maintenance technician began electrical work on energized control panel without applying lockout tagout.
Welding observed in hazardous area without a valid hot work permit. Flammable vapors detected nearby.
Worker observed at 6-metre height without harness or fall-arrest equipment. No edge protection installed.
Forklift operating in pedestrian walkway without segregation controls. Reversing alarms not functioning.
Near miss during crane lift: worker walked under suspended load. Exclusion zone had not been established.
Chemical spill in storage area. No PPE available for cleanup crew. SDS not posted.
Fire suppression system disabled for maintenance. No fire watch posted during hot work nearby.
Scaffold not inspected before use. Worker climbed to roof level without toe boards or guardrails.
Vehicle reversing without banksman in pedestrian area. Speed limit signs obscured.
